summary: The selected parser changes add spoiler spans and change how pipes are handled in tables. The supplied harness passes input controlled flags and Markdown to md_html, but the md_html implementation, renderer callbacks, header definitions, and build configuration are absent from the supplied evidence. Neither candidate can be resolved against the old harness, and no preexisting blocker is established.

claims.necessity_reason: The parser adds a spoiler span for paired double pipes, and the harness can supply flags and Markdown. The missing md_html and renderer paths prevent a conclusion about the target operation or an equivalent route.

before.requirement: Rendering a spoiler span from paired double pipes was not a parser capability.
before.reason: The before parser marks pipes only for tables or wiki links and has no pipe span rendering case.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The before inline renderer proceeds from tilde to dollar and link handling without a pipe span case.

after.requirement: With spoiler parsing enabled, paired double pipes must be reachable as a spoiler span through the md_html operation.
after.reason: The parser collects, resolves, and emits spoiler spans. The supplied evidence does not show whether md_html forwards the flag or how its HTML callbacks handle the new span.

claims.comparison_reason: The parser capability is new, while the harness already supplies arbitrary parser flag bits and remaining input bytes. The missing wrapper and renderer evidence decides whether that route satisfies the new obligation.
missing_information: Complete src/md4c-html.c::md_html on both sides, including parser flag forwarding.
Complete src/md4c-html.c::enter_span_callback and src/md4c-html.c::leave_span_callback on both sides.
The MD_FLAG_SPOILERS and MD_SPAN_SPOILER declarations in src/md4c.h.

claims.necessity_reason: The after parser treats double pipes separately from single pipe table boundaries. The missing md_html path and flag declarations prevent a supported target witness and satisfaction assessment.

before.requirement: Preserving a double pipe spoiler delimiter inside a table cell was not a parser capability.
before.reason: The before table pass analyzes pipe marks as cell boundaries; it has no spoiler delimiter handling.

after.requirement: With table and spoiler parsing enabled, double pipe spoiler delimiters must remain available within a table cell while single pipes delimit cells.
after.reason: The parser collects double pipes as two character marks and the table pass selects only unresolved one character pipes as boundaries. Whether the harness reaches this configuration through md_html is not supplied.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Table row processing invokes the inline table pass before constructing cell boundaries.

claims.comparison_reason: This table behavior is distinct from emitting a spoiler span in ordinary inline text. The harness supplies both flag bits and text bytes, but the wrapper and build path needed to establish reachability are missing.
missing_information: MD_FLAG_TABLES and MD_FLAG_SPOILERS declarations in src/md4c.h.
Build defaults and library target definitions in CMakeLists.txt and src/CMakeLists.txt.
Complete src/md4c-html.c::md_html, src/md4c-html.c::enter_span_callback, and src/md4c-html.c::leave_span_callback on both sides.
Relevant flag and span declarations in src/md4c.h.
CMakeLists.txt and src/CMakeLists.txt build defaults and target definitions.
